text.p: Summaries of European Cup matches played on Saturday: At Cardiff: Cardiff (Wales) beat Bath (England) 22-19 (halftime 9-6)
Cardiff - Try: Nigel Walker. Con: Jonathan Davies. Pens: Davies (3), Lee Jarvis (2).
Bath - Try: Nathan Thomas. Con: Mike Catt. Pens: Catt (4).
Leicester - Try: Richard Cockerill, Rob Liley. Cons: Rob Liley (2). Pens: Rob Liley (3)
Harlequins - Tries: Dan Luger, Will Carling. Pen: Paul Challinor.
Dax - Tries: Ugo Mola 2. Con: Richard Dourthe. Pens: Dourthe 2.
Toulouse - Tries: Michel Marfaing, penalty try. Cons: Christophe Deylaud, Thomas Castaignede. Penalties: Deylaud 2, Castaignede 2.
